caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically-oriented candlestick with a symmetrical, turned profile, rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite on a light beige background. The candlestick has a wide, circular base which tapers upward and curves into a narrower stem featuring a series of geometric contours, alternating between convex and concave shapes. Above the stem, the form transitions into a wider cylindrical section near the upper third of the candlestick before narrowing again and then flaring outward at the top to form a flat, circular drip tray. The entire object is shaded to suggest a metallic, reflective surface with light and dark gradients indicating highlights and shadows. The drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border. In the top right corner of the composition, there is a small square containing a simple top-down view of the candlestick as a pair of nested circles, labeled “1/2 SCALE TOP VIEW.” Near the bottom right corner, outside the inner border, is a handwritten signature or inscription that reads "S. LISWOOD."
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
